subject.title: Add Requesty as an OpenAI-compatible provider

question: Should Oracle make `REQUESTY_API_KEY` a first-class automatic gateway fallback, or support Requesty only through the existing explicit OpenAI-compatible base-URL path?
rationale: The security defect is mechanically repairable, but automatic environment-key discovery and precedence create a permanent provider behavior that cannot be inferred from existing generic endpoint support.

options.title: Explicit endpoint only
options.body: Document Requesty using the existing custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint path without adding implicit key selection or precedence.

options.title: First-class fallback
options.body: Keep automatic Requesty routing after trusted-host checks, compatibility tests, and inspectable live proof are added.

recommendation.title: Explicit endpoint only
recommendation.body: Document Requesty using the existing custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint path without adding implicit key selection or precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and has repeatedly maintained Oracle's OpenRouter and shared provider-routing contract.
